nodes.label: bin/test-gate Deploy Gate Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Wired into bin/compose so any --env/--prod deploy runs the full test suite (frontend lint/typecheck/test/build, ephemeral Rails+Postgres+Redis stack, Playwright e2e) first; a failure aborts before any build or container restart. Proven by deliberately breaking a spec and confirming the deploy aborted before dc build/prepare_db/dc up ran, with zero leftover containers. Later found bin/compose's 'up' case never ran dc build, silently redeploying stale images for three increments — fixed by making dc build unconditional.
